name: a1-intro
turns: Hey! I'm you, a few years on. Tell me, what do you do?
I am Minji. I am from Korea. I work in hospital. I am nurse.
A nurse! That's a tough job. Do you like it?
Yes I like it. But it is very busy. I don't have time.
I bet. What do you do on your days off?
I sleep. And I watch movie. My husband cook for me.

name: a2-weekend-past
turns: How was your weekend? Did you go anywhere?
Yes, on Saturday I go to Busan with my friends. We eat a lot of seafood.
Nice! Did you see the beach?
Yes we went to Haeundae. It was very crowded. I didn't swim because water was cold.
Ha, it's October. What's next for you this week?
I'm going to start a new project at work. I think it will be hard.

name: a2-trap-have-got
turns: Have you ever been to Japan?
No. I have a Japanese friend. She has two cats.
Two cats! Do you like cats?
I love cats but my apartment is too small. I want get a cat someday.

name: b1-story
turns: Oh yeah. So I was walking to the station when suddenly my phone rang, and it was my boss. He told me that the meeting was cancelled.
Exactly. So first I went to a cafe, then I called my mom. I haven't called her since two weeks, so she was happy.
Since two weeks, huh. Lucky mom.
If I have time tomorrow, I will visit her too.

name: b1-experience-errors
turns: Have you ever tried scuba diving?
Yes, I tried it two times. The first time was in Thailand in 2019.
I did. Did you ever see a turtle underwater? I never saw one before that trip, it was amazing.
Ha, I'm you, so no. Would you go again?
If I would have money, I would go every year.

name: b1-used-to-relative
turns: What were you like as a kid?
I used to be really shy. I used to hiding in my room when guests came.
Really? You don't seem shy now.
Yeah, that changed because of a teacher who believed in me. She's the person that made me speak in front of the class.
Do you remember her name? I forgot it. It might be Ms. Park.

name: b2-regret
turns: You sound a bit down. What happened?
I missed the deadline for the scholarship. I should have checked the date, honestly. If I had known it was on Friday, I would have finished the essay earlier.
There is one in spring, but by then I'll have graduated, so it doesn't apply to me. I wish I was more organized.
Maybe. I've been thinking about emailing them, although they probably get a lot of these.

name: b2-argue
turns: Do you think remote work is better?
Personally, I think a mix is best. Despite I save time on commuting at home, I miss my colleagues, who are honestly the reason I enjoy my job.
It depends. Whereas some people focus better alone, others need structure. Unless the company trusts people, remote work won't work.
Exactly, and also it should be decided by teams, not by managers alone. Does that make sense?

name: a2-shopping-problem
turns: Okay, I'm the shop assistant. How can I help?
Hello. I buy this jacket yesterday but it is too small. Can I change it?
Sure, do you have the receipt?
Sorry, I lost it. Can you check with my card? I paid with card.
Let me see. Yes, I found it.
Thank you! Do you have a bigger one? This one is more small than I thought.

name: a1-only-ai-structures
turns: If you had a free day tomorrow, what would you do? I've been wondering.
Uh, I sleep. Sleep is good.
Ha! Would you go out at all?
No. I stay home. I like home.

name: b1-fillers-asr
turns: What are you up to these days?
um so I am uh I am working on uh a new app and uh it is it is going quite well actually
it is for uh for learning languages I have been building it for about six months I think
Six months! Is it out yet?
not yet we are going to launch it next month if everything goes well

name: b1-advice-modals
turns: My friend wants to move to Germany. Any advice for him?
He should learn some German first. He must to register at the city office in the first two weeks.
Yes, and he has to open a bank account. It might take a long time, so he should start early.

name: b2-reported-questions
turns: Pretty intense. They asked me where do I see myself in five years, and then they asked whether I had managed a team before.
I said I had led a small team at my last job. By the time they asked about salary, I had already relaxed.

name: a2-routine-frequency
turns: What's a normal day like for you?
I usually wake up at six. I go always to the gym before work.
Not on weekends. On Sunday I never go out. I watch dramas all day and I eat many snacks.
